'''Yanga''' (Japanese: '''ヤンガ''' ''Yanga'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[HZ054|The Treasure of Eternity]]''. He is a researcher working for [[Exceed]], and a {{wp|Senpai and kōhai|junior}} of [[Friede]] from his time with the company.

==History==
{{incomplete|section}}
In [[HZ131]], Yanga met [[Friede]] at a bar in [[Levincia]]. After reporting to his former colleague about the situation at [[Exceed]], Friede showed him the research he had done on [[Laquium]] and its effects on Pokémon. After initially declining to help, Yanga agreed to assist Friede in uncovering the truth about the mysterious component.
